D1.scientific_premise: route compute to the uniquely best perspective (value of compute)
D1.new_premise_required: a router whose value beats matched-compute allocation on real tasks

U1.scientific_premise: calibrated confidence tracks correctness and is worth its verification cost
U1.strongest_null: real-data canary null (MNIST-family): raw uncertainty fires on irreducible items
U1.new_premise_required: an uncertainty signal that discriminates reducible from irreducible error

N1.scientific_premise: chase reducible structure not irreducible noise
N1.best_evidence: MNIST canary positive then CIFAR-10 null
N1.failure_mode: source-specific reducibility does not transfer across sources
N1.new_premise_required: a novelty signal whose reducibility transfers across sources

R1.scientific_premise: bounded retrieval selects information beyond recency/similarity/frequency/random
R1.strongest_null: KMNIST real-data canary_null: no incremental value beyond nearest-similarity
R1.failure_mode: learned retrieval did not beat nearest-similarity
R1.new_premise_required: a retrieval mechanism that beats nearest-similarity by SESOI across sources

P1.scientific_premise: hold stability and plasticity at matched cost

P1R.scientific_premise: predict per-item replay value to hold stability and plasticity
P1R.strongest_null: EMNIST external-method replication_null: faithful P1R 0.104 vs GDumb 0.594, above no-replay 0.068
P1R.failure_mode: per-item value prediction does not yield a competitive replay policy
P1R.current_classification: strongest_surviving_internal_hypothesis (same-team benchmark positives, external null, no downstream license)
P1R.new_premise_required: value used as a soft sampling priority over a representative buffer, made to beat GDumb

V1.scientific_premise: selective re-checking is worth its matched cost
V1.strongest_positive: incremental value over uncertainty controls (D lcb 0.062)
V1.strongest_null: only 1 of 3 capable estimators decodes it
V1.failure_mode: verification value not robustly decodable across capable architectures
V1.new_premise_required: verification value decodable by a capable estimator family, downstream-value targeted

K1.scientific_premise: repair fires only on detected disagreement and corrects material errors
K1.strongest_null: fails noisy-TV: fires on contradictions not warranting repair
K1.failure_mode: contradiction detection is not repair necessity
K1.new_premise_required: estimate repair necessity (net corrected-decision value), not mere disagreement

M1.scientific_premise: bounded causal messaging beats a limited broadcast
M1.strongest_positive: message value highly predictable (D lcb 0.33, F 3/3)
M1.strongest_null: fails noisy-TV: fires where the message does not causally help
M1.failure_mode: message predictability is not causal message value
M1.new_premise_required: estimate intervention-level (causal) message value vs a centralized matched-capacity control

E1.scientific_premise: carve the stream into meaningful events that aid downstream learning
E1.strongest_null: not beyond simple change detectors by SESOI (lcb -0.004)
E1.failure_mode: relational boundaries did not beat simple change detectors
E1.new_premise_required: model relations and temporal role changes simple change detectors cannot capture

C0.scientific_premise: a stable persistent trace aids downstream decisions
C0.strongest_null: worse than EMA smoothing (wrong direction, lcb -0.036)
C0.failure_mode: the trace did not beat EMA smoothing in downstream value
C0.new_premise_required: a trace whose downstream value exceeds EMA smoothing and matched-memory buffers

A1.scientific_premise: read action-relevance (affordance) straight from the latent
A1.strongest_null: ties a fitted value estimator; no incremental value
A1.failure_mode: affordance reading is not distinct from a fitted value estimator
A1.new_premise_required: an affordance readout that beats a fitted value estimator on the same latent

S1.scientific_premise: simulating the consequence beats acting reactively
S1.strongest_null: learned-model planning worse than random (model errors compound over the horizon)
S1.new_premise_required: simulation that conditions depth/trust on estimated rollout error and controls compounding

I1.scientific_premise: integrate confirmed subsystems into an escalating architecture
I1.new_premise_required: three externally confirmed functional domains with explicit dependency closure

G1.scientific_premise: cost-charged topology search over shadow coalitions
G1.failure_mode: no confirmed components to search over
G1.new_premise_required: at least one externally replicated component or confirmed cluster to compose

Cluster_A_action_simulation.scientific_premise: A1 and S1 interact to improve control beyond either alone
Cluster_A_action_simulation.strongest_null: unlicensed: A1 and S1 both pruned at admission
Cluster_A_action_simulation.new_premise_required: both A1 and S1 pass confirmation first

Cluster_B_memory_plasticity.scientific_premise: R1 retrieval and P1R replay interact to improve retention and adaptation
Cluster_B_memory_plasticity.strongest_null: blocked by R1 canary_null; factorial not licensed
Cluster_B_memory_plasticity.new_premise_required: a retrieval component that clears its own admission

Cluster_C_verification_repair_messaging.scientific_premise: a preregistered V1/K1/M1 subset beats the best simpler alternative
Cluster_C_verification_repair_messaging.strongest_null: unlicensed: V1 architecture_dependent, K1/M1 pruned; no passing subset
Cluster_C_verification_repair_messaging.new_premise_required: at least one confirmed reliability component

Cluster_Event_Trace.scientific_premise: E1 boundaries and C0 traces interact for downstream reasoning
Cluster_Event_Trace.strongest_null: unlicensed: E1 and C0 both pruned
Cluster_Event_Trace.new_premise_required: both E1 and C0 pass confirmation
